trends.whatProductOffers: Network general practitioner outpatient cover in Hong Kong, Macau and six designated Mainland GBA cities, usable at home or while travelling in the region.

keyFigures.label: Covered locations
keyFigures.value: Hong Kong, Macau plus Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Zhuhai, Foshan, Dongguan and Zhongshan
keyFigures.condition: Designated Mainland city list may be revised by AIA

exclusionsOrConditions: Online consultation with medication delivery is not available in Macau.
The insured must be physically in the same zone as the clinic providing the online consultation.
Online consultation is not applicable to an insured aged 5 or below on the consultation date.
Cover is limited to the plan's medical network and the designated city list can change.
clientSignalPhrases: worried about falling sick on business trips
clientProfileFit: Cross-border commuters and frequent GBA travellers
Hong Kong residents with family or a second home in the Mainland GBA
Retirees splitting time between Hong Kong and Guangdong
trends.talkingPointTemplate: Because {client_detail}, this plan keeps GP visits covered in Hong Kong, Macau and the Mainland GBA cities they actually travel through.
verificationPrompts: Confirm which GBA city the client spends time in
Check whether Macau cover matters to the client
Confirm the client accepts network clinics only
sourceEvidence: "medical network outpatient insurance to cover not only general practitioner consultations in Hong Kong, but also in Macau and designated Mainland GBA cities"
"The designated Mainland GBA cities currently include Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Zhuhai, Foshan, Dongguan and Zhongshan."
trends.notesForReviewer: Per-visit benefit amounts and annual visit limits are not in the extracted text.

trends.trendName: Two ways to see a GP
trends.whatProductOffers: Covers GP consultations either face to face with immediate medication or online with medication delivery; Plan 2 adds unlimited extra online consultations and one basic check-up per policy year.

keyFigures.label: Consultation channels
keyFigures.condition: Both through the plan's medical network

keyFigures.label: Additional online consultations
keyFigures.condition: Plan 2 only, after the outpatient visit limit is used; designated Mainland GBA cities only

keyFigures.label: Basic check-up
keyFigures.condition: Plan 2 only; specific network clinics in designated Mainland GBA cities

exclusionsOrConditions: Value-added services apply to Plan 2 only.
Additional online consultations and the check-up are not available in Hong Kong or Macau.
Medication delivery must be in the same zone as the consulting clinic and timing depends on the consultation.
Online consultation excludes insureds aged 5 or below.
clientSignalPhrases: no time to sit in a clinic
negativeSignalPhrases: expects the check-up in Hong Kong
clientProfileFit: Young professionals with little time for clinic visits
Parents wanting quick GP access for mild illness
Clients who mainly need routine consultation cover
trends.talkingPointTemplate: Since {client_detail}, two consultation channels with medication delivery fit treatment around their day.
verificationPrompts: Confirm whether the client needs online consultations or face-to-face only
Check which city the client would use the check-up in
Confirm the client accepts the visit limit
sourceEvidence: "flexibility to arrange either face-to-face consultation with immediate medication or online consultation with medication delivery"
"unlimited additional general practitioner online consultation and a designated basic check-up service per policy year"
trends.notesForReviewer: The number of included outpatient visits per policy year is not stated in the extracted text.

trends.whatProductOffers: Members activate the plan on the medical network portal, book GP appointments, and present a Health Card at network clinics with no subsequent claim procedures.

keyFigures.label: Claim procedures
keyFigures.condition: After activating the plan on the designated member portal

keyFigures.label: Consultation privacy
keyFigures.condition: Face-to-face consultations in Hong Kong, Macau and designated Mainland cities

exclusionsOrConditions: Portal activation is required before booking.
clientSignalPhrases: wants to just show a card
clientProfileFit: Frequent travellers who want quick access

verificationPrompts: Check the client's nearest network clinic
Confirm the client can use the member portal
Confirm no need for reimbursement outside the network
sourceEvidence: "By simply activating your plan on the medical network's designated member service online portal, you may start making appointments"
"No subsequent claim procedures will be required."

productLevelSummary.bestForOneLiner: A network outpatient plan for GP cover across Hong Kong, Macau and six Mainland GBA cities, with face-to-face and online consultation options.
notSuitedWhen: The client needs hospital, surgical or specialist inpatient cover
The client wants to see any doctor outside the network
The client lives outside Hong Kong, Macau and the covered GBA cities
